name: li_pkqty
parts: IDX_META (I64 [mode, kmin, qbase]): mode 1 when the index is present, the first l_partkey of the directory and the base coefficient of the quantity keys
IDX_OFFS (U32, nkeys + 1): directory over l_partkey kmin .. kmin + nkeys; entry e is the index positions offs[e] .. offs[e + 1]
IDX_ROWS (U32, one per lineitem row): the stored lineitem rows of facts in (l_partkey, l_quantity) order
IDX_QKEYS (U16, one per lineitem row): l_quantity - qbase (coefficients of scale 2) of the row at the same index position (the index's second key)

layout.summary: facts unchanged (75 inherited parts), then a composite index of lineitem on (l_partkey, l_quantity): a dense directory over l_partkey, the stored rows in key order, and the l_quantity key of each index position
layout.units: keys are bigint l_partkey values and l_quantity coefficients of scale 2 (quantity key = qbase + U16 code); offsets are index positions (U32); index rows are stored lineitem rows of facts (U32)
